description: Return all custom domains attached to a site, both those added with add_custom_domain (source 'mcp', with a recordId for verify_custom_domain or remove_custom_domain) and those linked in the VibeDeploy dashboard (source 'dashboard', verified or removed on the dashboard Web Addresses page at manageUrl). Call it before add_custom_domain to avoid adding a domain twice.

siteName.description: The site whose custom domains to list.

name: list_custom_domains

manageUrl.description: Source 'dashboard' only: the dashboard Web Addresses page where this domain is verified or removed.

note.description: Source 'dashboard' only: how this entry is managed.

recordId.description: Pass to verify_custom_domain or remove_custom_domain. Present on every source 'mcp' entry, absent on source 'dashboard' entries.

source.description: mcp: added with add_custom_domain or the site API. dashboard: linked on the dashboard Web Addresses page.

verificationRecord.description: Only present on source 'mcp' entries whose status is pending_verification.

title: List custom domains on a site
